changelog:
win-cleaner 1.0.1

- Updated description to include cleaning of Windows Store, .NET, game, and video-conferencing caches, and mention usage for storage optimization and C drive full scenarios.
- Added Phase 4e (Windows Store / .NET cleaning) and 5f–5n (app-specific cleanups) to the yield table and quick/deep clean instructions.
- Expanded safety rules: will not delete `.msi` or `.msix` files, or remove Windows Store app packages (only their caches), and will not disable hibernate/pagefile without user consent.
- Broadened scan and cleanup targets to include Teams, Cortana, Search Index, SCCM, and other common application/service caches.
- Improved instructions for user actions and clarification on protected areas and files.
summary: Deep clean Windows C drive junk files to maximize free space. Analyzes disk usage, identifies safe-to-delete items, and cleans caches, temp files, logs, brow...
